title: Gyrograph cluster-pool daily utilization chronicle - 2026-12-16
summary: This is an exported daily chronicle from the experimental 'Gyrograph' utilization dashboard. It aggregates per-cluster and per-pool utilization metrics, fragmentation signals, and short-term headroom forecasts for 2026-12-16 across NA / EU / APAC. Purpose: capture anomalous patterns in small-burst pools and provide quick operational actions for the infra on-call and capacity planners. This doc is a working export (raw numbers + quick commentary) and intentionally informal: contains hypotheses, TODOs, and immediate mitigations for tonight's shift.

notes:
Observations:
- ember-01 shows divergent behavior between interactive (good throughput) and batch (low slot consolidation). Suspect scheduling bin-packing for batch pool causing fragmentation_index=0.22.
- cobalt-05 (NA) is at 88.9% across batch; CI pipelines caused multiple long-running allocations (see INFRA-3421). Watch for spillover to on-demand pools tonight.
- opal-02 reserved capacity in EU has low utilization but high fragmentation in batch/spot mix; could be reclaimed for short-term burst if compliance tags match.
- APAC interactive cluster (aurora-03) spiky latency during core business hours; likely a mix of smaller user sessions plus a few heavy evals.
Hypotheses and quick checks:
- If batch pods are using small fixed-size reservations (4–8 GPUs) rather than elastic allocation we will see higher fragmentation index; check K8s resource requests for batch job templates (PR #812 touches this).
- Spot churn in EU explains high avg_slot_latency and idle sockets; evaluate spot eviction rates vs. reclaim window.
- Recent scheduler change (bin-pack tweak rolled 2026-12-10) might have regressed batch consolidation. Re-run consolidation test-suite on a staging cluster to reproduce.
action_items:
1) Immediate (on-call): throttle non-critical CI batch lanes on cobalt-05 for next 4 hours to relieve pressure (assign: Diego).
2) Short-term (24–48h): run eviction/repack job on opal-02 reserved pools to attempt 10% consolidation (assign: Priya).
3) Medium-term (1–2 weeks): audit batch job templates for request sizes and land consolidation heuristics (owner: infra-scheduling). Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/812.
4) Metrics: add a derived metric for `fragmentation_index` per pool 1h-smoothed and alert if >0.25 for >2 hours (owner: SRE).
5) Follow-up: schedule a 30-minute post-mortem if cobalt-05 stays above 85% for >6 hours (owner: Maya).
